basic_info.name: Ecom Express Limited
basic_info.description: Ecom Express: Delivering Over 1.9 Billion Reasons to Trust UsBased in Gurugram, Ecom Express was established in 2012 by veterans backed by 100+ years of collective logistics expertise. We aren't just a logistics provider—we're your partner in bridging distances and making connections. Our network reaches every corner, covering 27,000+ PIN codes in 2700+ towns, meticulously handled over 1.9 billion parcels in the past 10+ years.We're not just delivering; we're innovating with solutions like Ecom Magnum, comprehensive shipping services, fulfillment capabilities, Bulls.ai and drone technology—ensuring every package is delivered to the right location on time.Connect | Deliver| Grow https://bit.ly/4d0sHpV
